Delete Your EazyKhata Account

Last updated: April 2026

You can permanently delete your EazyKhata account and all associated data directly from within the app. No need to contact support.

How to Delete Your Account

  1. Open the EazyKhata app and sign in.
  2. Tap the Khata tab at the bottom of the screen.
  3. Scroll down to the Account section.
  4. Tap Delete Account.
  5. Read the confirmation prompt and tap Delete Permanently to confirm.

Your account will be deleted immediately upon confirmation.

What Gets Deleted

The following data is permanently deleted when you delete your account:

  • Your profile — name, email, phone number
  • All income and expense records
  • All invoices and Khata entries
  • All organisations and workspaces you own
  • Subscription and billing history
  • Support tickets and chat messages
  • Your sign-in account (Firebase Authentication)

What Is Not Deleted

If you are a member of another user's organisation (invited as a viewer or admin), that organisation's data belongs to the owner and is not affected by your account deletion. Your membership entry is removed.

Anonymised aggregate analytics (no personally identifiable information) may be retained for product improvement purposes.

Retention Period

Account deletion is processed immediately. Any residual data in backup systems is purged within 90 days.

Can't Access the App?

If you are unable to sign in and wish to request deletion, email us at support@eazykhata.in from the email address associated with your account. We will process verified deletion requests within 14 business days.

Contact

For any privacy-related questions: support@eazykhata.in
